locator.text: Equation (7.21), p. 80, in the statement of Lemma 7.4

evidence: paper: cP(v) \le x(v) \le CP(v), \qquad \frac{y(v)}{x(v)} = c_0\sqrt{1+s(v)^2} + O(S_*^{-1}).

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same two clauses, with the paper's unspecified constants made explicit. (i) cP ≤ x ≤ CP: `radialPrimary` is the coefficient of e_r in the Lean reconstruction `tangent ρ B x y = pack x ((-ρ x)•B 0 + y•B 1)` (MovingFrameODE.lean:94), matching the paper's x in t = x(e_r − s_a K_a) + y N_a with ρ = radialSlope n = n_r/|n_tan| = s_a; the Lean constants are c = exp(−(D+2C)L)/2 and C = 3exp((D+2C)L)/2, and it adds 0 < x. The Lean's P is any positive solution of the reference scalar equation P' = (λ − referenceDamping)P (instantiated as PrimaryPulseBounds.referenceP / referenceEnvelope), where the paper fixes P(v) to the envelope of (7.12). (ii) y/x = c₀√(1+s²) + O(S_*^{-1}): `primary_bounds` states |y/x − h| ≤ 4|h|·coneConstant(λmin,C)/S with h = d.eigenvector, i.e. the O(S_*^{-1}) is an explicit bound with S the slot scale; the identification h = c₀√(1+s(v)²) is the definition `referenceProfile` (hypothesis `hprofile` of primary_gaussian_bounds, and definitional for the constructed family in primary_ratio_error). The Lean writes the slope unsigned, slotMagnitude u ell v = u/2 + u·v/ell, where the paper has the signed s(v) = σ(u_*/2 + u_* v/L_s) (PhaseEstimates.signedSlot); only s² enters, and BasePhaseGeometry.signedSlot_sq supplies slope² = slotMagnitude², so the rewriting is routine. c₀ is PrimaryRepresentatives.c0 F g = lambda0 F g / coupling F g with coupling = 2F·(g/‖g‖)_θ and lambda0 = √(−coupling(coupling+‖g‖)), which is the paper's c0 = λ0/(2F0 N_θ) with λ0² = −2F0N_θ(2F0N_θ+|g0|), same sign (negative).
